intent: A vertical step list for a running agent task: done steps with durations, the current step with a live timer, then pending steps.
useWhen: show what an agent already did and is doing now
a run log next to a chat or an ApprovalCard
a step that waits for approval inside a longer task
doNotUseWhen: what the agent intends to do before it runs — AgentPlan
a project roadmap of now / next / later — Timeline
wizard steps a person fills in — ProgressSteps

steps.note: { id, label, status: "done" | "running" | "approval" | "pending" | "failed", duration?, timer?, sublabel? }[]. duration for finished steps, timer for the running or approval step, sublabel for the tool call in mono.

tag.note: Small neutral mono tag after the title, e.g. a branch.

progress.note: { current, total } overrides the counter. Default: first unfinished step over the step count.

selectedStepId.note: Selected step id; its button shows the selected ring and aria-pressed.

onSelectStep.note: (id | null) => void. Makes each step a button; selecting the selected step again passes null.

requirements: the running or approval step has aria-current=step
each step names its status for screen readers; icons are aria-hidden
the running spinner rotates on transform only and stops under prefers-reduced-motion
with onSelectStep, each step's label and sublabel are one button with aria-pressed

doNot: Do not invent a local AgentTrail, RunLog, or StepList
Do not use Timeline or ProgressSteps for an agent run
Do not use raw hex for status colors
Do not put actions in the trail; approvals go in ApprovalCard
snippet: <AgentTrail title="Implement login rate limit" icon="GitPullRequest" steps={[{ id: "1", label: "Read auth module", status: "done", duration: "4.1s" }, { id: "2", label: "Awaiting approval", status: "approval", timer: "0:18", sublabel: "write_file src/middleware/auth.ts" }, { id: "3", label: "Run unit tests", status: "pending" }]} />
